title: Bot VTOL rider pick-up / carry polish

facts.title: VtolArrive rider sink ignored the ground ahead: the craft sank its BattleArmor into a block short of the flag (SinkAhead)
facts.fact: Inside 90 m of a rider's stop vt_arrive asked the stick for -30 (sink) until the craft was at max(ground at the point + 12, ground straight under the craft + 10). The same rule held bot 5's two riders snagged on a 16.4 m block for 2.4 s at 0 m/s with full forward stick (t=39.8-42.2). SinkAhead raises the height asked to the highest ground the craft reaches in the next 1.5 s (along its velocity and toward the point, +-4 m abeam) + 11 m with a rider (+ 6 m without). A sink left set also outlived its step: v29d4 (BD) the craft kept -30 through 0.8 s of steps that flew no stick branch after the brain turned to lift-climb, 27 -> 4 m over the ground; a negative lift demand is now cleared at the start of every ctrl_tick and re-asserted only by whoever still wants it.
facts.how_to_use: Switch SinkAhead / RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_SINK_AHEAD (default on). [C7] sinkahead: held_s. Branch v29-vtol (exe v13-v29v10).

facts.title: Bot VTOL pick-up flew in at cruise height and sank 12 m on MoveTo only once over the BattleArmor (PickupGlide)
facts.fact: PickupGlide: inside 80 m the craft sinks while it brakes, to the BattleArmor + 11 m (+0.15 m per m beyond 20 m out), never under the ground ahead + 6 m, so it arrives at claw height. On the recording the glide starts 1.3-2.0 s before the old hover sink began.
facts.how_to_use: Switch PickupGlide / RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_PICKUP_GLIDE (default on). [C7] pickupglide: sink_s. g_vt_pickup is set round the cargo-3 run in (ma2_bot_ctrl.c ORD_TRAVEL cargo branch).

facts.title: VtolTwoRiders held a VTOL with a rider aboard 8-11 s for a pilot still boarding a BattleArmor (TwoQuick)
facts.fact: With one rider aboard the VtolMuster hold looked for a second BattleArmor within 50 m or a teammate's boarding claim on a suit within 70 m and held 8-11 s. TwoQuick: aboard, only a teammate already in a BattleArmor within 35 m is held for, 4 s at most; a boarding claim is not waited for. The player keeps his 8-11 s (25 s as CtfPair partner).
facts.how_to_use: Switch TwoQuick / RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_TWO_QUICK (default on). [C7] muster held_bot / gave_up, tworiders hold_second_bot.

facts.title: A bot BattleArmor on a bot's VTOL let go mid-air when any goal outscored the ride's flat 1.5 (RiderStay)
facts.fact: Riding a bot's VTOL (not a flag-run member, not carrying) the brain scored G_RIDE 1.5; an objective (defend/hunt), power-up or retreat score above it took the goal while the BattleArmor hung on, its order left IDLE and the claw let go. RiderStay: aboard a bot's VTOL the ride wins outright (order_ride alone decides to let go), and 'cornered' lets go only once the VTOL is under 10 m/s. Also: near a lift request's destination (150 m) the rider let go at once, 34 m up, while the VTOL still flew in (v29f3 t=137.3); now it waits until it hangs under 14 m or is within 40 m.
facts.how_to_use: Switch RiderStay / RECOMP_BOT_RIDER_STAY (default on). [C7] riderstay: held_s.

facts.title: A VTOL with a rider aboard scored its lift a flat 1.2: support/attack took it off the run mid-carry (CarryCommit)
facts.fact: With someone aboard, ma2_bot_brain.c scored G_LIFT 1.2 (0 under 30 % health), so G_SUPPORT / attack / objective scores beat it and the craft left the run with its rider hanging. CarryCommit: with a rider aboard and over 30 % health the lift outscores every other goal; under 30 % the old scores stand (repair / retreat).
facts.how_to_use: Switch CarryCommit / RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_CARRY_COMMIT (default on). [C7] carrycommit: held_s. Branch v29-vtol, exe v13-v29v10.

facts.title: Rider strikes on New River City towers: the craft clears a ~42 m top at its 48 m ceiling, its rider 4.7 m lower does not (RiderDodge)
facts.fact: RiderRay only learns a shut way after a hit. RiderDodge: with a rider aboard, each stick step checks 30-100 m toward the steer point (+-5 m abeam); where the ground stands above the local ceiling - 10.5 m it flies the nearest clear heading (+-20.90 deg) instead. Replayed on the three strikes it fires 0.6-2.0 s before each hit with +20.+90 deg clear.
facts.how_to_use: Switch RiderDodge / RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_RIDER_DODGE (default on). [C7] riderdodge: steer_s, none_s.

facts.title: VtolEdgeAll recovery MoveTo fought the stick by NRC red base: ferry with rider hung 14-50 s (EdgeSlide)
facts.fact: An out-of-bounds area lies on the straight line from New River City's red base to the blue flag. The red ferry (rider aboard, 45-75 m up) sat 24 m off it: the carrot led into the band, vt_edge_recover's MoveTo pushed it back out every other step and the parked window's MoveTo climbed it to 75 m -- 0-2 m/s for 51 s (v29b1 rc30 t=13-64), 42 s (v29a2), 14 s (v29d5). EdgeStickOut only helps with the nose pointing outward. EdgeSlide: on a travel leg 60 m+ long the recovery flies the stick along the edge (distance-field tangent on the side of the point, kept 4 s; 20-35 m on plus out to 36 m) instead of MoveTo straight out. Red exits in v29f1/f3 (v8+) took 0-4 s.
facts.how_to_use: Switch EdgeSlide / RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_EDGE_SLIDE (default on). [C7] edgeslide: slide_s; [BOT-EDGESLIDE] with RECOMP_BOT_DIAG.

facts.title: The VTOL stick needed world y > 6 m: over Bogged Down's bog (y -16.-12) a craft never got it and sank (LowStick)
facts.fact: ctrl_travel flew the stick (vtol_manual) only with me->pos.y > 6, a world height that assumed NRC's ground at ~0. Bogged Down's bog lies at -16.-12: a pick-up there fell to the awake drive, sank into the bog and with its rider aboard could not climb (v29f2 blue bot 7 t=165.3-173: lift-climb at 0 m/s, vy -5, rider off four times, 12 s). LowStick: 6 m over the terrain under the craft also qualifies. Replay: 101 frames of that stretch would have had the stick.
facts.how_to_use: Switch LowStick / RECOMP_BOT_VTOL_LOW_STICK (default on). [C7] lowstick: n_s.
